title: cyclamen coum subsp. elegans
intro: Cyclamen coum subsp. elegans, commonly known as winter-flowering cyclamen or Persian violet, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant is known for its heart-shaped leaves and delicate, nodding flowers in shades of pink, white, or purple. The leaves and roots of Cyclamen coum subsp. elegans have been traditionally used for their medicinal properties, which are said to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
